Content: There will be one world with true humanity.  Family valued and connected.   Shared resources.  Health.  Happiness.  Trust flowing like a stream.  Dance, music, joy, freedom, solidarity, kindness all flow like a river.
Hope is abundant.
People are open minded.  They deeply appreciated new ideas that become built upon until something is implementable.
We understand multiple languages at the core.  Status is no longer a thing.  We appreciate what everyone brings.
Community is accessible to kids and people with disabilities.
Ease and choice would be the norm.

There will have been so much space for grieving.  We will continue holding space for grieving.  We will know how to hold space for the end of things.  We will tell stories of ancestors who navigated the grief of everything that was normal to them coming to an end.
Palestine is free. Our future is connected to the now of the dreaming time.
Everyone has freedom inside the womb of the world.
We see the life hidden inside life.
We get to be bored. Boredom leads to pleasure.
We have come to terms with death and dying.  We have gotten to a place where death is natural.  It is no longer man-made.  We have reestablished our relationship with death.

A turquoise sea surrounded by green plants and a breeze that gives safety. Sun, music, good food, laughter, friends new and old. There is harmony in all the spaces that we choose to live. We have the freedom to speak and create. There is no longer code switching – only poetry. We have freedom to be ourselves. We sleep deeply and rest.
We decommodify the life-giving conditions, nature, and the things we need to survive.
We feel and move according to our gut–our Intuition.  We feel our feelings and they arise, and keep moving!
A boat: Move into surrender for a world that works for all beings. Joyfulness, death, all people feel joy. We are guided by a dream space that is grounded and connected to roots.
Operate/function from a place of alignment with our authentic selves.
Normalize authenticity.

Ancestral knowledge is normalized. Each person/community would openly celebrate and honour their connection to Ancestors, and the genetic memories and wisdom we carry in our bodies are always accessible.
We are brave enough to ask questions. We know that we don’t know everything.
Reclaiming rest / restoring vs continual productivity as a place of worth. Rest would be part of being sustainably a healthier human.
Creativity would be celebrated more than the finished product.
We still have dogs.  And they’re cute and happy and fed and have cozy beds to sleep on
We can sit in silence, together or alone
Shared sense of empathy for all living things that can be physically felt between people
Rest and slowness are valued, people can breathe easily.
Wisdom and generosity earn respect
We acknowledge the fallacy of independence and live into the physical, emotion, spiritual, historical interdependence of people and cultures
People laugh at the stuff that hurts.

Not all moving in the same direction but holding space and joy for eachother. Finding joy and comfort in the enough. To breathe life into the dreams of others. Interweaving the darkness of uncertainty with dazzle.

The Goddess has returned. We are moving back into the feminine. We are reading women and that changes our perspective. God is a goddess and that translates into justice, education systems, more of our male beings embody this. There is no such thing as the voiceless. We give more of a fuck and are less of a horses ass.

There is a shifting from ego and depletion of the self. Shifting to respect for self, higher consciousness and the earth. Technology and science are keys to improved sustainability and prosperity for everyone on earth. More than half Ho-Ho’s. Learning is an experience of creativity, life skills, and science.
Closer connections among peopleCloser connections among people
The whole container of humanity is held in a way where everyone belongs and matters.  Belonging and mattering flow like a river of air through all of humanity.

We recognize that everything is connected, and the magnitude of our vision continues to expand.  We are self-regulated - and our self regulation comes in benevolent forms. Everything is connected, our exchanges are all connected.  Everything is important, and we are at peace.
We are fully present and breathing in the moment, and we are nourished. We wild craft.  We eat more nutritious foods.

There is a unity across this world where humanity sees animal and plant species as relative to us. Our cosmovisions are aligned to this old way of being that had been forgotten but when we lost everything before, we found what was important: our faith, our faith in the land and our people.
People have respect for interplanetary personhood and people no longer have an urgency to leave when they have a place to call home. Space will be held in reverence to a universal place in the world.
We are spiritually connected, present, and awake.

The light of the collective was so much brighter than we could ever achieve on our own. What is one flame compared to a bonfire? Soon, all we cared about was our Collective flame. We left ideas of self and individualism in the ashes of what had passed.
Live out of respect for nature & animals
Nature guides us and wards us. We listen, we accept. We own our part and take action, after listening.
Violence is an abomination.
Where life thrives, life thrives. It’s safe to change unexpectedly.
It feels free to be calmness and stillness.
Humanity is humble in the face of mystery. All people have work that calls in their genius and wisdom. We wake up with a feeling of wonder and possibility and go to sleep truly tired.

We integrate that we are harmful as a species, telling it in a way that makes it clear that we would never need to do that now because we learned but having a way to tell that story without ever having to go back there.
The world is founded on principles of love, holistic health, healing, regeneration, truth, care, integrity, joy, creativity, and knowledge.
We strive to find the equipoise of the collective and the individual.
There is more color in the world.  Not everyone is happy, but thriving is prevalent.  Art is a part of life.
Anxiousness and fear no longer dominate people.
We still have wonder in the things we don’t know.
We take time to research, be curious, and evolve.

Needs are provided and wants have possibility

There is ʻieʻie in the mountains, food growing in the ground, and fish filling the waters. There is lightness in the air, the winds are doing what they are supposed to be doing.

Culturally, a rebalancing of feminine and masculine energy has created an environment of nurturing, compassion, and mutual aid. To the eyes of our ancestors, it perhaps looks futuristic and utopian - a solar punk vision of morality and mutuality without religious rigidity and exclusion — yet aware of the gifts and genius of the past, and a responsibility to enable the gifts and genius of the future. The environment is elegant in its simplicity, clean, green, visibly sustainable - a decluttered environment that enables a decluttered mind, more able to perceive reality for what it is.
We embrace and honor the silence and build that into our living. The ones who talk the loudest also value silence.
Flow of wisdom. Safety, security, honesty, openness to others, sense of abundance, interdependent wealth, faith, trust in self, community, moral compass, everyone has value and is appreciated.
Honored humanity, pursue life with purpose/passion, not shackled to a job for survival,  World feels smaller.   Sense of agelessness.
Honesty, kindness, strength, covering for the weak.

Multigenerational living, shared housing, community farming, trading and bartering, slower day to day. Meals are shared. Responsibilities are shared, We have time for each other.
We are recycling, using old materials not just throwing it away.
We have stepped away from the things that take us away from truth, divinity, the teachings of the animals and seasons.

Sunrise and birdsong starts the day. Everyone is deeply supported, supremely safe, incredibly stable and firm in who they are which enables them to be present and not get swirled up in human drama. Everyone can contribute their passion and gifts to their community.

From the minute you step out the door, you know you are enough.  You are greeted by others.  When you come to work, you are appreciated for all of your experiences.  You are safe.  You are seen.
